name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
target_audience: Urban street vendors, hawkers, thela-walas, and small roadside merchants
short_description: Affordable collateral-free working capital loan to empower urban street vendors to resume and expand their livelihoods.
full_description: PM SVANidhi was launched to provide micro-credit facilities to urban street vendors. Vendors can avail an initial working capital loan of up to ₹10,000, followed by ₹20,000 and ₹50,000 on timely repayments with a 7% interest subsidy and cashback on digital transactions.
benefits: Collateral-free working capital loan: 1st tranche up to ₹10,000 (1 yr tenure), 2nd tranche up to ₹20,000, 3rd tranche up to ₹50,000. 7% interest subsidy credited directly to bank account. Up to ₹1,200/year cashback on digital payments.

key_rules: Applicant must be engaged in street vending in urban or peri-urban areas.
Possession of Certificate of Vending (CoV) / Identity Card issued by Urban Local Bodies (ULB) OR a Letter of Recommendation (LoR).
Must have an operational bank account linked with Aadhaar.
No previous default in formal institutional micro-loans.

required_documents: Certificate of Vending (CoV) or Letter of Recommendation (LoR) from ULB/Town Vending Committee
application_process: 1. Verify urban vending status via Town Vending Committee survey list. 2. Submit e-KYC via Aadhaar. 3. Select preferred lending institution / bank. 4. Digital sanction and direct disbursement into account.
tags: street vendor, loan, working capital, small business, urban, collateral-free, mudra, subsidy

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
target_audience: Small, marginal, and landholding farmer families across India
short_description: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments of ₹2,000 directly into the bank accounts of farmer families.
full_description: PM-KISAN is a central sector scheme with 100% funding from Government of India. It aims to supplement the financial needs of landholding farmers in procuring inputs to ensure proper crop health and appropriate yields, commensurate with the anticipated farm income.
benefits: ₹6,000 per annum paid in three 4-monthly installments of ₹2,000 each directly transferred via DBT into Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts.

key_rules: Farmer family must own cultivable land registered in their name.
Institutional landholders and serving or retired government employees/pensioners (>₹10,000/mo) are excluded.
Income tax payers of previous assessment years are not eligible.
Mandatory Aadhaar e-KYC and land seeding in portal.

application_process: 1. Online registration at PM-KISAN portal or CSC center. 2. Enter land details and Aadhaar number. 3. Verification by State Patwari / Nodal Officer. 4. Direct DBT installment release.
tags: farmer, agriculture, income support, dbt, rural, crop, fertilizer, kisan

name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
name_hindi: आयुष्मान भारत - प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
target_audience: Bottom 40% vulnerable and low-income families identified by SECC
short_description: Cashless health insurance coverage of up to ₹5 Lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.
full_description: AB-PMJAY is the world's largest government-funded healthcare assurance scheme. It provides a health cover of ₹5,00,000 per family per year across empaneled public and private hospitals across India for over 1,900 medical procedures without co-payment.
benefits: Cashless and paperless access to healthcare services up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year at public and empaneled private hospitals. Covers pre-existing diseases, diagnostics, medicines, ICU, and surgical procedures.

key_rules: Families identified under Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC 2011) criteria or state NFSA/Ration Card lists.
Deprivation criteria in rural areas (kutcha houses, no adult earning member, SC/ST, manual scavengers).
Occupational categories in urban areas (ragpickers, domestic workers, street vendors, transport workers).
No restriction on family size, age, or gender.

required_documents: Family ID Card / SECC verification slip
application_process: 1. Check eligibility on Mera PM-JAY portal or at nearest Ayushman Arogya Mandir / CSC. 2. Biometric e-KYC with Aadhaar. 3. Instant generation of Ayushman Golden Card. 4. Cashless treatment at empaneled hospitals.
tags: health, insurance, medical, hospitalization, surgery, free treatment, bpl, ayushman card

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U 2.0)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
target_audience: Urban EWS, LIG, and Middle Income Families with no pucca house
short_description: Financial assistance and interest subsidy up to ₹2.67 Lakh for building or buying a pucca house in urban areas.
full_description: PMAY-U addresses urban housing shortage among EWS/LIG and MIG categories by ensuring a pucca house to all eligible urban households. Assistance is provided via Credit Linked Subsidy (CLSS), Beneficiary Led Construction (BLC), and Affordable Housing in Partnership (AHP).
benefits: Direct grant assistance of ₹1.5 Lakh to ₹2.67 Lakh; Interest subsidy on home loans up to 6.5% for 20 years; Basic amenities including toilet, water, and electricity connection.

key_rules: Beneficiary family must not own a pucca house in their name anywhere in India.
EWS annual household income up to ₹3 Lakh; LIG household income up to ₹6 Lakh.
Female ownership or co-ownership of the house is mandatory for EWS/LIG homes.
House must be constructed with prescribed disaster-resilient standards.

required_documents: Aadhaar Card of all family members
Income Proof / Salary Slip / Affidavit of Income
Proof of no pucca house (Self-declaration affidavit)
Land Ownership Documents (if applying for Beneficiary Led Construction)
Voter ID / Electricity bill for address proof
application_process: 1. Apply online via PMAYMIS portal or ULB citizen center. 2. Aadhaar e-KYC and family verification. 3. Physical site verification by municipality. 4. Staged disbursement linked to construction milestones.
tags: housing, pucca house, home loan, subsidy, urban, shelter, clss, construction

name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
target_audience: Traditional artisans and craftspeople working with hands and tools in 18 identified trades
short_description: Holistic support for traditional artisans with skill training, ₹15,000 modern toolkit incentive, and collateral-free loans up to ₹3 Lakh at 5% interest.
full_description: PM Vishwakarma is designed to recognize, skill, and uplift traditional artisans such as carpenters, blacksmiths, goldsmiths, potters, cobblers, tailors, and sculptors. It provides formal certification, skill upgradation, toolkit grants, subsidized credit, and digital transaction incentives.
benefits: PM Vishwakarma Certificate & ID card. Basic (5-7 days) & Advanced (15+ days) training with ₹500/day stipend. ₹15,000 e-voucher for modern toolkits. Collateral-free credit: 1st tranche ₹1 Lakh, 2nd tranche ₹2 Lakh at highly subsidized 5% interest.

key_rules: Artisan must be engaged in one of the 18 eligible traditional family-based trades on the date of application.
Should not have availed loans under PMEGP, PM SVANidhi, or MUDRA in the last 5 years with outstanding dues.
Registration limited to one member per family.
Serving government servants and their family members are not eligible.

required_documents: Trade Specific Proof or Self-declaration of traditional artisan practice
application_process: 1. Biometric verification at Common Service Center (CSC). 2. Three-tier verification: Gram Panchayat / ULB, District Implementation Committee, and Screening Committee. 3. Vishwakarma digital ID issuance. 4. Skill training & loan sanction.
tags: artisan, craftsman, carpenter, tailor, potter, toolkit, skill training, loan, vishwakarma

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
target_audience: Non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises and budding entrepreneurs
short_description: Collateral-free business loans up to ₹20 Lakh across Shishu, Kishore, and Tarun categories for setting up or scaling small enterprises.
full_description: PMMY provides loans to small and micro enterprises in manufacturing, processing, trading, or service sectors. Loans are categorized into Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishore (₹50,000 to ₹5 Lakh), Tarun (₹5 Lakh to ₹10 Lakh), and Tarun Plus (up to ₹20 Lakh).
benefits: No collateral or third-party guarantee required. Reasonable interest rates. Mudra RuPay Debit Card for working capital flexibility. Zero processing fee for Shishu and Kishore loans.

key_rules: Applicant must have a viable non-farm business or proposal for establishing one.
Must not be a defaulter with any financial institution or bank.
Repayment tenures range from 3 to 7 years with flexible moratorium periods.

required_documents: Proof of Business Address (Udyam Registration / Rent agreement / Trade License)
Bank Account Statement for last 6 months
Business Plan / Project Report for Kishore & Tarun loans
application_process: 1. Prepare business proposal. 2. Apply via Udyamimitra portal or visit any public/private commercial bank or NBFC. 3. Document verification. 4. Sanction and Mudra card issuance.
tags: mudra, business loan, startup, shopkeeper, collateral free, enterprise, shishu, kishore, tarun

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
target_audience: Parents or legal guardians of girl children under 10 years of age
short_description: High-interest, government-backed savings scheme with Section 80C tax exemption dedicated to securing the girl child's education and future.
full_description: Part of the 'Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao' initiative, Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana offers an attractive sovereign-guaranteed interest rate (currently 8.2% p.a.) with compounding benefits, EEE tax status, and guaranteed safety for girl children under age 10.
benefits: Highest sovereign interest rate among small savings schemes (8.2% p.a.). Triple tax exemption (EEE). Minimum deposit ₹250/year up to ₹1.5 Lakh/year. Account matures after 21 years with partial withdrawal allowed at age 18 for higher education.

key_rules: Account must be opened by parents/guardians in the name of a girl child below 10 years.
Maximum two accounts per family (three allowed in case of firstborn or second-born twins/triplets).
Account can be transferred anywhere across India to any post office or authorized bank.

required_documents: Birth Certificate of the Girl Child
Identity Proof of Parent/Guardian (Aadhaar / Voter ID / PAN)
Passport size photographs of Child and Guardian
application_process: 1. Obtain Form-1 from nearest Post Office or authorized commercial bank. 2. Attach birth certificate and KYC. 3. Deposit initial amount (min ₹250). 4. Passbook issued.
tags: girl child, savings, education, beti bachao, tax exemption, post office, high interest

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST/OBC Students
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
target_audience: Undergraduate, diploma, and postgraduate students from SC, ST, and OBC families
short_description: Complete tuition fee reimbursement and monthly maintenance allowance for students pursuing higher education.
full_description: The scheme provides complete financial assistance to students belonging to Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, and Other Backward Classes studying at post-matriculation or post-secondary stage to enable them to complete their higher education.
benefits: 100% compulsory non-refundable fees reimbursed directly to university/college. Monthly maintenance allowance up to ₹13,500 per year for hostellers and ₹7,000 for day scholars. Study tour and thesis charges covered.

key_rules: Candidate must have passed Class 10 (Matriculation) from a recognized board.
Candidate must be enrolled in a recognized university, college, or polytechnic institution.
Combined family annual income from all sources must not exceed ₹2,50,000.
Candidate must not be holding any other government scholarship simultaneously.

required_documents: Caste Certificate issued by competent revenue authority
Current College Admission Receipt & Fee Structure
application_process: 1. Register on National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) with OTR (One-Time Registration). 2. Submit application with academic & fee details. 3. College verification. 4. DBT release to bank account.
tags: scholarship, student, education, college, tuition fee, sc, st, obc, degree

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
target_audience: Unorganized sector workers aged 18 to 40 years
short_description: Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 after age 60 with government backing for unorganized workers.
full_description: APY is a pension scheme focused on all citizens in the unorganized sector. The subscriber receives a guaranteed minimum monthly pension of ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000, or ₹5,000 after attaining the age of 60 years until death, followed by spouse pension and return of pension wealth to nominee.
benefits: Guaranteed lifetime monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000. Same pension continues to spouse upon subscriber's demise. Accumulated pension corpus (up to ₹8.5 Lakh) returned to nominee. Tax benefits under Section 80CCD.

key_rules: Open to all Indian citizens aged between 18 and 40 years.
Must possess an active savings bank account or post office account with auto-debit facility.
Citizens who are income tax payers are not eligible to join APY from October 2022 onwards.

application_process: 1. Visit bank branch or log in via netbanking/APY mobile app. 2. Provide savings account details and set up auto-debit mandate. 3. Receive PRAN (Permanent Retirement Account Number) card.
tags: pension, retirement, social security, unorganized worker, monthly income, old age, safety

name: Stand-Up India Scheme
target_audience: SC, ST, and Women entrepreneurs setting up greenfield enterprises
short_description: Bank loans between ₹10 Lakh and ₹1 Crore for SC/ST and Women entrepreneurs to establish greenfield manufacturing, service, or trading units.
full_description: Stand-Up India facilitates bank loans between ₹10 Lakh and ₹1 Crore to at least one SC or ST borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up a greenfield enterprise in manufacturing, services, agri-allied activities, or trading sector.
benefits: Substantial loan financing from ₹10 Lakh to ₹100 Lakh covering up to 85% of project cost. Margin money support through convergence with central/state schemes. Handholding support via SIDBI portal.

key_rules: Enterprise must be a greenfield project (first-time venture in manufacturing, services, or trading).
In case of non-individual enterprises, at least 51% shareholding and controlling stake held by an SC/ST or woman entrepreneur.
Borrower should not be in default to any bank or financial institution.

required_documents: Pollution Control Board Clearance (if applicable for manufacturing)
application_process: 1. Register on Standupmitra portal (standupmitra.in). 2. Submit project proposal and loan request. 3. Bank appraisal and lead generation. 4. Loan sanction and disbursement.
tags: entrepreneur, women entrepreneur, sc, st, startup, factory, large loan, greenfield

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
target_audience: Pregnant women and lactating mothers for first and second live births
short_description: Direct cash incentive of ₹5,000 to ₹6,000 for wage-compensation and nutritional support during pregnancy and child birth.
full_description: PMMVY provides financial incentive directly to pregnant women and lactating mothers (PW&LM) to compensate for wage loss during pregnancy, promote institutional delivery, and encourage good child health and immunization practices.
benefits: Cash incentive of ₹5,000 for first child in two installments; ₹6,000 for second girl child in single installment upon complete immunization. Directly credited to mother's Aadhaar-seeded bank account.

key_rules: Mother must register pregnancy at nearest Anganwadi Centre / Health Facility within 570 days of Last Menstrual Period (LMP).
Women in regular employment with Central or State Government or PSUs are not eligible.
Mother must possess an individual bank account seeded with Aadhaar.

required_documents: Proof of BPL / EWS / SC / ST status or income declaration
application_process: 1. Register at nearest Anganwadi center or ASHA worker or online at pmmvy.wcd.gov.in. 2. Verification of antenatal checkup (ANC) records. 3. Direct DBT transfer.
tags: pregnancy, mother, nutrition, maternity benefit, newborn, child care, dbt

name: Lakhpati Didi Initiative (DAY-NRLM)
target_audience: Women members of Self-Help Groups (SHGs) in rural areas
short_description: Comprehensive skill training, interest subvention, and market linkage enabling rural SHG women to earn at least ₹1 Lakh per year.
full_description: Under Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM), Lakhpati Didi trains rural women in high-value livelihood activities such as drone operation (Namo Drone Didi), food processing, animal husbandry, agro-enterprises, and digital financial services.
benefits: Free vocational skill development and business incubation. Interest subvention on SHG bank loans up to ₹3 Lakh. Equipment access, drone training, community resource person guidance, and digital e-commerce market linkage (GeM, e-SARAS).

key_rules: Candidate must be an active member of a registered women Self-Help Group (SHG) under DAY-NRLM.
Commitment to adopt micro-enterprise or multi-livelihood interventions to attain sustainable annual income of ₹1,00,000+.
Must be willing to undergo prescribed cluster-level training modules.

required_documents: SHG Membership Book / Certificate from Village Organization
Individual and SHG Bank Account Passbooks
application_process: 1. Express interest through SHG Village Organization (VO). 2. Livelihood mapping and business plan preparation with Community Resource Person (CRP). 3. Training & credit linkage via Gram Panchayat.
tags: shg, women, rural, lakhpati didi, self help group, livelihood, drone, tailoring, animal husbandry
